Database._comment: Connection string Vault'tan gelir (Maximum/Minimum Pool Size dahil). EnableRetryOnFailure BİLİNÇLİ OLARAK kullanılmıyor — kod tabanında manuel BeginTransactionAsync ile çalışan servisler EF'in retry execution strategy'siyle çakışıyor (bkz. DependencyInjection.cs notu). Bu değer sadece command timeout içindir.

Security._comment: Task 14 (2026-09-07): explicitly configures the previously-unset TrustedProxies key. Program.cs's GetClientIp fails OPEN (trusts X-Forwarded-For/X-Real-IP from any connecting IP) when this is empty/absent, which it was in every appsettings*.json before this change — a real, live gap matching the same rate-limit-bypass class of bug documented in GetClientIp's own 2026-07-30 comment. The current deployment topology (docker-compose.yml) puts every nexora-api-N instance on the single 'nexora-network' bridge (subnet 172.27.0.0/16) with nexora-lb (nginx) as the only component that proxies external traffic in. Restricting trust to that subnet means forwarded headers are only honored when they arrive via that bridge network, matching this topology; if the API is ever exposed directly (bypassing nginx) on this same network, this CIDR alone does not distinguish nginx from any other container on it — a real remaining caveat, see task-14-report.md.

Kestrel._comment: Instance başına eşzamanlı bağlantı/istek kapasitesi. Çoklu instance (nginx upstream) ile toplam kapasite = instance sayısı × bu değerler. MaxRequestBodyBytes 115MB'a yükseltildi — vatandaş başvurularına 100MB'a kadar video/fotoğraf eki için (bkz. appsettings.json Kestrel yorumu). nginx/reverse-proxy tarafında da client_max_body_size aynı şekilde ayarlanmalı.
